tasks.short: Evaluate repair against pre-accident market value

steps.what: Verify the actual vehicle identity, condition evidence, repair estimate and claim context needed to compare repair with the vehicle's pre-accident value.
outputs: Verified appraisal context and repair-cost inputs

steps.what: Retrieve actual comparable pre-accident market-value evidence in the authorised vehicle valuation system {OTHER}, checking vehicle specification and condition relevance.
Assemble the actual repair-cost and market-value comparison in the working appraisal {SPREADSHEET}, retaining the source amounts and explicit uncertainties.
outputs: Draft arithmetic comparison and source references

steps.what: Evaluate practicality of repair as opposed to payment of market value of vehicle before accident, checking the comparison against actual evidence and repair uncertainty.
inputs: Actual source evidence and claim context
outputs: Appraiser's actual repair-versus-value recommendation and limits

steps.what: Write and check the actual evaluation, rationale, source values and unresolved uncertainty in the claims-record draft {OTHER}.
Save the exact checked repair-versus-value evaluation in the claims system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native vehicle-value filters in the authorised valuation system {OTHER} and source-linked comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The appraiser verifies the evidence, judges repair practicality and records the actual recommendation in the claims system {OTHER}; no claim settlement or payment is made.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant value evidence and repair amounts are manually assembled into a comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native vehicle filters and deterministic source-linked comparison fields.
tasks.still_hard: Comparable condition, hidden damage and practical repair uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: An evidence-based appraisal rather than a mechanical threshold decision.

ambition.what: No automated total-loss or payment decision is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less comparison assembly, with appraisal and settlement authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Vehicle filters and arithmetic comparison can assist appraisal without deciding whether repair is practical or payment is authorised.

assumptions: Conditional baseline includes actual manual value retrieval and comparison assembly. Shares are E1 design estimates, not measured insurance baselines.

Actual repair estimates come from the existing appraiser/repair-estimating workflow and their original preparation is not saved here. s1 verifies vehicle id, specification, condition, estimate id/version, amounts and uncertainty. Authorised valuation sources provide comparable id, date, specification and value; missing or unsuitable comparables require manual research within s2-s4.

Test native valuation filters and comparison fields before custom code. If the source cannot export verified amounts, manual assembly remains and s3 savings must be reduced. Existing automatic calculation runtime earns no saving. No new structured condition score is presumed.

The ordinary completed-record check supplies the requested save gate without an extra approval stage; edits void it. Same-system save retains its real short time. Settlement, claimant communication and bank payment are distinct unchanged workflows with no saving claimed.
research_questions: Can native source-linked comparisons reduce assembly while preserving the appraiser's treatment of condition and uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence checks, residual value lookup, practical judgment, record writing and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and check comparison-field failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual evaluation record checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 40% value retrieval + 15 actual comparison assembly = 23 gross less 2 upkeep. Already integrated or unsuitable sources yield zero; judgment and save retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Agree repair costs with the repair shop

steps.what: Review the actual repair shop estimate against the appraiser's version in the repair-estimating system {OTHER}, locating changed parts, operations, quantities and rates.
Review repair cost estimates with automobile repair shop to secure agreement on cost of repairs, discussing actual disputed work and reaching proposed terms within the appraiser's mandate.
inputs: Actual repair evidence and authority limits

steps.what: Write the actual agreed line changes, exceptions and repair-cost confirmation in the claims-system draft {OTHER} after the shop discussion.
Check the completed agreement record and confirmation against actual discussed terms, final estimate version, mandate and repair-shop recipient.
outputs: Checked exact repair-cost record, confirmation and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked repair-cost agreement record in the claims system {OTHER}.
Send the exact checked repair-cost confirmation to the verified repair shop through the claims system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact confirmation and recipient checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure a native version-difference view in the repair-estimating system {OTHER}. The appraiser negotiates personally, writes the actual resulting terms and checks the completed record and confirmation before separate save and send actions in the claims system {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Two estimate versions are manually scanned for changed lines.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version comparison by established estimate and operation identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the proposed repair work and cost are justified and acceptable.
tasks.human_edge: Technical negotiation and agreement within a real mandate.

ambition.what: No automated bargaining or settlement authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less estimate comparison; negotiation remains human.

reach.task: Discuss valuation differences with a specialist

evidence.claim: Native version comparison can highlight repair-estimate differences without negotiating or approving repair terms.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual estimate review, shop discussion, resulting written terms and confirmation. Shares are E1 conditional workflow estimates.

The shop and appraiser already produce their own estimate versions; no labour is newly transferred to them. Required comparison fields are claim/vehicle id, estimate version, operation or part id, quantity, rate and amount. s1 obtains actual versions; unmatched narrative lines require manual reading within s1-s2.

Test native version comparison first. Actual meaning and disputes are fully reviewed; no transcript or structured agreement feed is free. s3 writes new agreed content manually. Discussion develops the actual terms; final formal confirmation follows the completed-version check and real mandate.
Changes after s4 void both gates. Saves and sends retain short full time; existing comparison runtime earns no saving. No claim payment, repair purchase order or coverage decision is hidden.
research_questions: Does native line comparison reduce actual reading effort without losing repair operations that use different codes?

already_counted.description: Residual version reading, actual negotiation, resulting terms, final check and separate actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain estimate-version and operation matching settings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual cost-agreement record checked in s4
Exact final cost confirmation and repair-shop recipient checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 30% version retrieval/comparison reduction = 6 gross less 1 upkeep. Already compared estimates yield zero; negotiation, terms, approval and tails retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve the actual claim, vehicle and completed repair-estimate sources in the claims and repair-estimating systems {OTHER}.
inputs: Existing actual estimate and supporting sources
outputs: Current source set for the insurance form

steps.what: Determine the actual appraisal recommendation and permitted form content from the verified estimate and evidence, resolving conflicting or incomplete information.
outputs: Actual recommendation and verified form-field selection

steps.what: Prepare insurance forms to indicate repair cost estimates and recommendations in the claims system {OTHER}, placing actual selected source fields into the required form draft.
inputs: Verified field selection and actual recommendation from s2

steps.what: Check the completed form's recommendation meaning, claim and vehicle identity, cost lines, totals, evidence, final version and intended insurer recipient.
outputs: Checked exact insurance form and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked insurance form in the claims system {OTHER}.
Submit the exact checked insurance form to the verified insurer recipient through the authorised claims exchange {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact form and insurer recipient checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure native source views and form-field mappings in the claims system {OTHER}. The appraiser supplies the actual recommendation, reconciles the completed insurance form to its sources and separately saves and submits the exact checked version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Already established estimate and claim information is repeatedly placed into insurer forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form templates and source-field mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the recommendation and exceptions are supported by the actual appraisal.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable recommendation and final form interpretation.

ambition.what: No automated claim approval or denial is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less form assembly; appraisal and submission responsibility remain human.

evidence.claim: Native insurance form mappings can reuse actual claim and estimate data while leaving recommendations and final review human.

assumptions: Conditional baseline is actual manual form assembly, not existing automatic generation. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured insurer baselines. Insurer-facing independent-appraiser branch is shown.

Existing appraisal processes produce actual estimate lines and evidence; this task does not claim to save their original preparation. s1 retrieves claim id, vehicle id, estimate id/version, part/operation lines, quantities, rates, amounts and source references. Appraiser produces actual recommendation text and field selection in s2. Missing or unsupported fields require manual form entry and reduced s3 saving.

Test native forms and field mappings first. s3 copies actual recommendation text rather than generating a claim decision. Full meaning and numerical checks remain in s4. No source-capture or insurer labour is transferred into savings.

Final completed-form checks bind both action gates; subsequent edits void them. Save and submission remain short fully retained actions. No payment, coverage decision or claimant notice is hidden in the form submission.
research_questions: Can native form generation preserve actual estimate versions, recommendation wording and recipient scope without rekeying?

incremental.description: Maintain insurer form versions and source-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed form checked in s4
Same exact form and insurer recipient checked in s4

steps.what: Read the actual vehicle specification and damage inspection evidence for the repair estimate, resolving uncertain identity or missing damage details.
Determine the actual repair operations and candidate parts needed for the observed damage using automotive repair knowledge.
outputs: Actual selected repair operations and candidate parts

steps.what: Look up standard automotive labor and parts cost manuals in the authorised repair-estimating system {OTHER}, checking actual model applicability, operation times and cost versions.
inputs: Actual selected operations and parts from s2
Existing authorised manuals and rate sources
outputs: Verified applicable parts, time and rate sources

steps.what: Enter the actual selected parts, quantities, operation times, applicable rates and justified adjustments into the repair-estimate draft {OTHER}.
Estimate parts and labor to repair damage by extending the actual captured quantities, times and rates into line amounts and totals in the repair-estimating system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual captured estimate lines from s4

steps.what: Check the completed estimate against actual damage, selected operations, source applicability, units, rates, totals and explicit uncertainty.
Save the exact checked parts-and-labour repair estimate in the repair-estimating system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure model-specific manual views and fixed line calculations in the authorised repair-estimating system {OTHER}. The appraiser selects actual repair operations, captures quantities and adjustments and checks the completed estimate; software retrieves source candidates and calculates only the entered lines.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual source navigation and repeated arithmetic or line extension consume estimating time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native specification filters and configured estimate calculations.
tasks.still_hard: The repair scope, hidden damage and applicability of standard operations.
tasks.human_edge: Automotive judgment about what work is actually needed.

ambition.what: No photo-only damage or automated repair decision is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less retrieval and arithmetic; technical appraisal remains human.

evidence.claim: Native repair-manual filters and fixed quantity/rate calculations can reduce actual clerical estimating work without selecting the repair scope.

assumptions: Conditional baseline has actual manual source navigation and arithmetic/line assembly. Shares are E1 workflow estimates, not measured appraiser baselines. Already automated calculations yield no benefit and must be removed from claimed gross saving.

Actual inspection evidence is an existing source from the physical appraisal workflow; its original collection is unchanged and receives no saving here. Appraiser verifies vehicle and evidence in s1, chooses operations in s2, reads authorised source id/version, model applicability, time units and rate in s3 and captures actual quantities and adjustments in s4. Missing or incompatible source fields require manual estimating.

Native filters and formulas are tested before code. No structured damage diagnosis is assumed and no parts are ordered, repairs commissioned or claim paid. The actual scope judgment and manual capture retain all time.

The ordinary completed-estimate check supplies the requested gate with no extra self-approval stage; edits void it. Same-system save retains its short real time. Downstream comparison and insurance forms reuse this saved estimate rather than claiming its preparation again.
research_questions: Which source navigation and arithmetic steps remain human today after existing estimating-system functions are excluded?
